title: Comparison Between Elliptical Domed Mesh Technique and Lichtenstein Technique in Inguinal Hernia
brief_summary: The investigators describe a new surgical technique for inguinal hernia open repair, which will be compared with the Lichtenstein technique. The investigators seek to find the difference between the two techniques in postoperative pain.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adult patients diagnosed with uncomplicated primary inguinal hernia
* mentally healthy patients
* patients without preoperative groin pain
* patients eligible for outpatient surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients with different surgical diagnosis
